material.description: Surface: js/client/feedback.js. Principle: Make Illegal States Unrepresentable (ILLEGAL). The armed state can be set with no position: onEvent 'targetArm' sets armed.on=true (feedback.js:89-94) while the only writer of armed.client is the pointermove listener (feedback.js:108). drawTargeting hides both reticle and area when `!armed.on || !armed.client` (feedback.js:161). The producer arm() in scenarios/moba/controls.lua:201 sends slot, item, radius and targetKind, and no pointer position. Symptom: a targeted or ground-target cast armed before any pointer movement since page load shows no reticle and no area ring. Witness: codesearch literal 'armed.client' (feedback.js:108,161,167,172) and 'targetArm' (controls.lua:201). Fix direction, not applied: carry the pointer position in the arm event, or fall back to the last known screen position.
material.subject: Targeted-cast reticle and area ring stay hidden after arming until the pointer moves
material.witness: js/client/feedback.js:94 falls back to viewport centre when armed.client is unset; live eval of the pushed module at a9a03005 after targetArm with no pointermove: reticle display=block (verify-illegal-trav-feedback-1). CI ci run 40111900750 success 6/6.
